title: Correction to Doc 146 section 6, repair A

corrects.claim: FreeVirtualMemory documented as unused available virtual memory, that is, commit limit minus commit charge
corrects.status: second half was reviewer inference, not documentation

documentation.FreeVirtualMemory: defined only as virtual memory currently unused and available (KB); CIM_OperatingSystem example is free RAM plus free paging space; no mapping to system commit limit minus commit charge
documentation.MEMORYSTATUSEX.ullAvailPageFile: process-limited available commit; at most the system-wide value; documentation directs to GetPerformanceInfo CommitLimit - CommitTotal for system-wide
documentation.PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION: pages plus PageSize; system commit headroom = (CommitLimit - CommitTotal) x PageSize; available physical = PhysicalAvailable x PageSize

corrected: system commit cannot be taken from FreeVirtualMemory on documentary grounds; equivalence gap, not a measured difference; needs a documented system-wide source (GetPerformanceInfo, or existing performance counters if readable in time)

FreePhysicalMemory vs AvailableBytes closeness (15-63 MiB in three runs) is empirical only, not documented equality and not a commit mapping; keep the OS physical check and add a documented available-physical source
keep both 512 MiB floors (physical and system commit) and all failure/missing/invalid/late refusals
